svg.title: Host enforcement lanes
svg.desc: Claude Code and Codex rewrite noisy calls and replace oversized output. Antigravity denies known command floods, while connector results can only be persisted after return. The ctx-owned Antigravity SDK is bounded by construction.
svg.text: THE HOST CONTRACT DETERMINES THE GATE
Known command floods and connector results take different paths.
* denial costs one turn; agent re-issues ctx run; connector output cannot be substituted
